context.transcript:
We're proud of our windows here at National Window Retailers.
We offer a wide variety of windows from the country's largest manufacturers so that our customers won't have to shop around anywhere else.
We guarantee that with our large inventory, you will always find the right product for your needs.
Our competitors can't beat that.
Right now, go to our website to take advantage of a special limited-time discount only available online.
But hurry, this offer ends soon.
context.transcript_translation:
我们在 National Window Retailers 非常自豪。
我们提供来自国家最大的制造商的各种窗户，这样我们的顾客就不必去其他地方购物了。
我们保证凭借庞大的库存，您总是能找到适合您需求的正确产品。
我们的竞争对手无法做到这一点。
现在就访问我们的网站，利用仅在线提供的限时折扣。
但请快点，此优惠即将结束。
